title: Shopper Earnings Terms — Holding Cartwise Shopper Batches One at a Time
content:
**Condition 1 — one batch in progress.** A shopper may hold only 1 batch of Cartwise Shopper Batches in progress at a time. A new batch can be accepted only when every other batch held under the same shopper contractor account is completed, dropped, canceled or finalized.

**Condition 2 — account and level.** The shopper's contractor account must be active, and the batch type must be one the shopper's level allows. Which levels may take Express 30 Batches, Stock-Up Batches, heavy items and alcohol, and how many orders a shopper may carry at once, are set by the terms of Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts.

**Condition 3 — completed batches.** Completed batches accumulate without limit.

## What counts as "in progress"

The test is read from the system's batch records for the same shopper contractor account, as they stand before the new batch is accepted; what the shopper says about other batches does not replace those records.

| Status of another batch on the same contractor account | Does it stop a new batch from being accepted? |
|---|---|
| Accepted | Yes |
| Shopping | Yes |
| Delivering | Yes |
| Completed | No |
| Dropped | No |
| Canceled | No |
| Finalized | No |

## Worked cases (hypothetical)

- A shopper whose only other batch is delivering cannot accept a new batch until that batch is completed (or otherwise leaves the in-progress statuses).
- A shopper with forty completed batches and one canceled batch, and nothing accepted, shopping or delivering, may accept a new batch; completed batches place no limit on it.
- Two batches are counted together only when they sit under the same shopper contractor account.
